page.overview:
Who is Steam-Roller?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Steam-Roller was available in 1987, boxed exclusively with the Mobile Command Center. This is the only version of Steam-Roller ever released. ---- Appearance: black hat with "DOG" on front; red hair; no shirt; open black vest with green grenades; red heart tattoo on left shoulder; brown gloves; light brown pants with brown belt and boots

Accessories: stubby grey dagger with ribbed handle. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/87/steamroller.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/87/steamroller.shtml Filecard]
